endOfService.title: End-of-service gratuity calculator
endOfService.detailsTitle: Calculation details per Saudi Labour Law
endOfService.step3FirstFive: • First five years ({{years}} years) × ½ month = {{amount}} SAR
endOfService.step3AfterFive: • Beyond five years ({{years}} years) × full month = {{amount}} SAR
endOfService.useProvisionDesc: Mark this if you accrue an annual end-of-service provision (debit side will be the EOS provision account instead of expense).
endOfService.endEmploymentDesc: Set the employee status to "Terminated" and record the end date.
endOfService.journalNote: A journal entry will be created: from {{debit}} {{amount}} to {{credit}} {{amount}}.
endOfService.toastPaidTitle: Gratuity paid and journal entry created
endOfService.importantNote1: On resignation: no gratuity before two years, ⅓ from 2-5 years, ⅔ from 5-10 years, full after 10 years (Article 85).
endOfService.importantNote2: On unjustified employer termination: full gratuity (Article 84).
endOfService.importantNote3: The wage used is the gross wage (basic + fixed allowances), not including overtime or variable commissions.
endOfService.importantNote4: A working woman who terminates her contract due to marriage within 6 months of the marriage date is entitled to the full gratuity.

calculators.title: HR calculators — per Saudi Labour Law
calculators.fieldSickDays: Sick leave days in the year *
calculators.hintAnnualBody: Annual leave balance is 21 days, becoming 30 days after 5 continuous years. Balance is cumulative, and if the contract ends with unused days they are paid in cash at the gross wage (basic + housing + transport) ÷ 30.
calculators.hintSickBody: Per year an employee gets: 30 days at full pay, then 60 days at 75% pay, then 30 days unpaid. After that the employer may end the contract (Article 82).
calculators.hintOvertimeBody: Overtime hour wage = normal hour wage + 50% (×1.5). Normal hour wage = monthly wage ÷ days per month ÷ hours per day.
calculators.hintGosiBody: For Saudis: 10% deducted from employee + 12% pensions on employer + 2% occupational hazards. For non-Saudis: 2% occupational hazards on employer only. Insurance wage cap = 45,000 SAR (basic + housing).
calculators.hintNoticeBody: An open-ended contract is terminated with 60 days notice from the employer and 30 days from the worker. If notice is not given, payment in lieu of full notice period is due.
calculators.hintProbationBody: The default probation period is 90 days. It may be extended in writing up to 180 days. During this period either party may end the contract without notice or gratuity.
